animation.origin: right to left (inactive collapses right, expands left on hover)

linkActive.indicator: underline via pseudo-element at full width

characterDescription: A compressed, slender nav bar sitting at 40px height — trimmed 10px from the warm-tallow source — that reads as a typographic ribbon rather than a structural band. Uppercase Inter at 0.75rem with 0.12em letter-spacing gives each link the spacing of an engraved plate. The right-to-left underline animation wipes in with 0.45s ease-in-out, synchronized with the motion system's base duration. The slimmer height concentrates attention on the cream page below rather than the nav itself.

_twist.description: Nav height reduced from 50px to 40px (−10px), intensity 3. The slimmer bar creates more visual pressure toward the content below — the nav becomes a hairline declaration rather than a structural band. Letter spacing and underline animation preserved from warm-tallow source.
